extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: This policy outlines Humana's preventable inpatient readmission review standards.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Payment Policy
extracted_content.subsection: Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: References > Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. The following policy applies to facility services only. For Humana Medicaid plans, this policy applies except when not permissible by state Medicaid guidelines.

extracted_content.title: General Readmission Review Requirements
extracted_content.content: All readmissions, to the same facility, reimbursed using Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) methodology are subject to review to determine if the readmission was preventable.

extracted_content.title: Preventable Readmissions
extracted_content.content: If Humana determines that a readmission was preventable, Humana does not allow payment for the second admission since reimbursement for the first admission includes reimbursement for the second admission. The following are examples of preventable readmissions. This is not an all-inclusive list:

extracted_content.title: Preventable Readmissions
extracted_content.content: Premature discharge that resulted in a readmission. This is based on information that the provider or physician knew, or should have known, at the time of discharge.

extracted_content.title: Preventable Readmissions
extracted_content.content: Care rendered during the second admission that should have occurred during the first admission.

extracted_content.title: Preventable Readmissions
extracted_content.content: An inappropriate transfer.

extracted_content.title: Preventable Readmissions
extracted_content.content: A readmission that was not medically necessary.

extracted_content.title: Preventable Readmissions
extracted_content.content: A readmission that is an attempt to circumvent Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) payment.

extracted_content.title: Separately Payable Admissions
extracted_content.content: If Humana determines that a subsequent admission was not preventable or was unrelated to the prior admission, Humana may allow separate payment for each admission. The following are examples of admissions that may be separately payable:

extracted_content.title: Separately Payable Admissions
extracted_content.content: An admission that is due to a reoccurrence of a chronic condition and is not a continuation of the previous episode's admission.

extracted_content.title: Separately Payable Admissions
extracted_content.content: An unrelated readmission, including an unrelated same-day readmission. Facilities cannot be held responsible for readmissions beyond their control, which may include, but are not limited to, the following:

extracted_content.title: Separately Payable Admissions
extracted_content.content: Failure of the patient to follow discharge instructions. This requires documentation that instructions were properly communicated to a patient or caregiver who was both not impaired and capable of following the instructions.

extracted_content.title: Separately Payable Admissions
extracted_content.content: A condition caused by post-care services provided beyond the facility's control.

extracted_content.title: Separately Payable Admissions
extracted_content.content: A readmission after the patient left the same facility against medical advice.

extracted_content.title: Nonpreventable Readmissions
extracted_content.content: Humana does not allow payment for the following types of readmissions since they are required to be reimbursed as part of the prior admission:

extracted_content.title: Nonpreventable Readmissions
extracted_content.content: A planned readmission.

extracted_content.title: Nonpreventable Readmissions
extracted_content.content: A readmission after a leave of absence.

extracted_content.title: Nonpreventable Readmissions
extracted_content.content: A same-day related readmission.

extracted_content.title: Definitions of Italicized Terms
extracted_content.content: Diagnosis Related Group (DRG): Under IPPS, each inpatient admission is categorized into a case which is called a DRG. Each DRG has a payment weight assigned to it, based on the average resources used to treat Medicare patients in that DRG.

extracted_content.title: Definitions of Italicized Terms
extracted_content.content: Same facility: Is an entity that owns or controls the facility for the first admission, an entity owned or controlled by the facility for the first admission, or an entity that is under common ownership or control as the facility for the first admission.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.content:
Diagnosis Related Group (DRG): Under IPPS, each inpatient admission is categorized into a case which is called a DRG. Each DRG has a payment weight assigned to it, based on the average resources used to treat Medicare patients in that DRG.

Same facility: Is an entity that owns or controls the facility for the first admission, an entity owned or controlled by the facility for the first admission, or an entity that is under common ownership or control as the facility for the first admission.
